open_points.subject: M24 EffectApproval.request_digest vs owner decision 18
open_points.text: "the fully built request as the owner was shown it — method, URL, headers and body... The credential's value is never shown, so rotating it voids nothing." + "request_digest: the digest of the fully built request shown; the approval covers that request only"
open_points.question: When request headers include credential-backed values, what exact header representation is covered by request_digest so that credential rotation does not invalidate an already approved request?
options: Digest the literal outbound headers (including secret values)

open_points.subject: M26 EffectAttempt creation scope by effect class
open_points.text: "The record written before an effect is sent" and authority includes "for a `draft-write` send the flow activation" but no class rule states whether `read` operations produce EffectAttempt records.
open_points.question: For which operation effect classes must an EffectAttempt exist: only non-read effects, only approval-gated effects, or all operation calls including `read`?
options: Create EffectAttempt for all operation classes including `read`
open_points.default_guess: Create EffectAttempt for non-read classes (`draft-write` and above), not for `read`.

open_points.subject: M21 disclosure_class rule for zero-input trial cases
open_points.text: "a trial case's expected output the highest class among that case's inputs, as a trial execution's output does"
open_points.question: If a trial case has no inputs (function with zero input ports), what disclosure_class is assigned to expected outputs and trial execution outputs?
options: Require explicit class on expected outputs
